confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Morocco's price level, not live listings. Restaurant anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which is least certain. Cocktail and wine use local price relationships to beer (cocktail about 2x beer, wine glass about 1.5x beer) because direct knowledge is weak. The FX observation came from a search-result summary of the RBA overview page and was not checked against the F11.1 table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general Moroccan price levels for a mid-sized northern port city with steady domestic and European tourism. Priced somewhat above interior cities and below European capitals. No specific comparable city was used.
